reasons_add: Al-Ṭabarī describes Saqar as a part of Hell named Saqar.
Al-Ṭabarī also describes Saqar as a gate of Hell.
Al-Ṭabarī explains its indeclinability by saying that Saqar is one of Hell's names.
Al-Ṭabarī says the following question asks Muhammad what Saqar is.
Ibn Kathīr says God will immerse the threatened man in Saqar from every side.
Ibn Kathīr identifies the threatened man as al-Walīd.
Al-Itqān also reports al-Jawālīqī's view that Saqar is foreign.
